legend: As is well known, the Earth revolves around the Sun, while the Solar System itself moves through space, and so on.
Andrew−13$$$Andrew-13$$$ became interested in whether the sum of these movements could be exactly zero. Therefore, he asks you to solve the following problem:
It is known that the motion of some object is described by vectors →v1,⋯,→vn$$$\vec{v_1}, \cdots ,\vec{v_n}$$$. You need to determine whether the sum of these vectors can be equal to the zero vector.

However, instead of the vectors themselves, you are only given their possible lengths (the directions of the vectors may be arbitrary). The lengths are given as segments, that is, vector number i$$$i$$$ may have any length belonging to the segment [li;ri]$$$[l_i; r_i]$$$.
For a vector →v=(x,y,z)$$$\vec{v} = (x, y, z)$$$, its length is defined as |→v|=√x2+y2+z2$$$|\vec{v}| = \sqrt{x^2 + y^2 + z^2}$$$.
input: The first line of the input contains an integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤2⋅105$$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of vectors.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers l1,l2,…,ln(0≤li≤109)$$$l_1, l_2, \ldots, l_n\, (0\le l_i \le 10^9)$$$.
The next line contains n$$$n$$$ integers r1,r2,…,rn(li≤ri≤109)$$$r_1, r_2, \ldots, r_n\, (l_i \le r_i \le 10^9)$$$.
output: If it is possible to choose directions for the vectors and choose some lengths from the segments [li;ri]$$$[l_i; r_i]$$$ so that their vector sum is equal to the zero vector, then output in a separate line their lengths a1,⋯,an$$$a_1, \cdots , a_n$$$ (li≤ai≤ri)$$$(l_i \le a_i \le r_i)$$$ such that it is possible to choose suitable directions for them so that their sum is the zero vector.

legend.ai: 众所周知，地球绕太阳公转，而太阳系本身也在空间中运动，如此等等。
Andrew−13$$$Andrew-13$$$ 开始对这些运动的总和能否恰好为零产生了兴趣。因此，他请你解决以下问题：
已知某个物体的运动由向量 →v1,⋯,→vn$$$\vec{v_1}, \cdots ,\vec{v_n}$$$ 描述。你需要判断这些向量的和能否等于零向量。
不过，你得到的并不是这些向量本身，而只是它们可能的长度(向量的方向可以是任意的)。这些长度以区间形式给出，即第 i 个向量 $$$i$$$ 可以取属于区间 [li;ri]$$$[l_i; r_i]$$$ 的任意长度。

接下来一行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 r1,r2,…,rn(li≤ri≤109$$$r_1, r_2, \ldots, r_n\, (l_i \le r_i \le 10^9)$$$)。

output.ai: 如果能够为这些向量选择方向，并从区间 [li;ri]$$$[l_i; r_i]$$$ 中选择一些长度，使得它们的向量和等于零向量，那么请单独一行输出它们的长度 a1,⋯,an$$$a_1, \cdots , a_n$$$(li≤ai≤ri)$$$(l_i \le a_i \le r_i)$$$，使得可以为这些向量选择合适的方向，使它们的和为零向量。
